boundary.endingEvent: The second listen spends a turn; its monster scan calls restrap(), the successful rn2(3) roll reaches set_mimic_sym(), the mimic re-disguises and forfeits its move, the listen returns, and the queued wait sentinel is consumed at the next input boundary.
boundary.validInputs: Debug Healer seed 2 at 20270318143000 with `blind,pettype:none,!acoustics,!autopickup,time,playmode:debug`; dismiss startup, create a small mimic with #wizgenesis, wait once while it is disguised, listen south twice, dismiss prompts, and leave a final wait sentinel. Exact input is `.\x07small mimic\n.acj acj .` with literal control-G and newline.
boundary.observables: The second listen's turn cost, restrap guard and rn2(3) order, successful and failed redisguise rolls, asleep/frozen post-roll returns, Protection_from_shape_changers short-circuiting before selection randomness, set_mimic_sym state and presentation, planning-clone isolation, one unconsumed sentinel at the old refusal, and exact PRNG/screens/cursors through the next input boundary.
boundary.exclusions: Off-map remains parked on Q10. Mixed corpse/statue ordering, hallucination, REVIVE_MON, out-of-reach/tiny statues, statue contents without a trap, restrap ROOM behavior already ported, and unrelated monster actions remain unchanged. Do not broaden mimic creation, monster movement, or shape-changing beyond the source branches this live consumer reaches.
